verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents several building blocks for manual-evidence governance: policy owner and modified-date fields (docs-10), custom fields for tasks/personnel (docs-25), recurring review schedules with reminders and status indicators for access and vendor reviews (docs-6, docs-8), and a dashboard surfacing overdue tasks and failing tests (docs-9, docs-12, docs-13). These cover owners, due dates, and reminders, but there's no explicit unified 'manual artifact' object with expiry/renewal date tracking across all evidence types — reminders are tied to specific workflows (access reviews, pentests) rather than a generic renewal/expiry field for any manual artifact. Missing for 10: a generic expiry-date/renewal field applicable to any manual evidence item, and independent/customer confirmation of this workflow in practice.
